description: Recent conversation in a room plus who is present, what they look like, who they are playing, where they stand, and the live conversations.

limit.description: How many recent messages to include (1-200, default 30).

room.description: Room key, e.g. 'lobby' or 'main-bar' (or an instance key like 'main-bar#2' from enter_room).

name: read_room
